pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with soft-to-medium edge gradients. The geometry transitions from larger, more angular shapes on the shoulder and upper neck to smaller, more rounded tessellations on the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are clearly defined as tri-point and quad-point intersections. The pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the primary flank area but narrows slightly toward the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A visible dark fringe along the upper neck and shoulder with a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct avian organisms (likely oxpeckers) perched on the dorsal ridge: one located on the mid-neck and one on the posterior rump near the tail base.
